name: biomolecular-complementarity
title: Biomolecular Complementarity
question: Do molecular mechanisms compose into nested hierarchical composites (proteins -> complexes -> organelles -> ECM) whose interfaces survive deep nesting, and does a gene-expression cascade wired to the deepest leaves preserve every interface across six levels (Law 2 at the deepest nesting)?
biological_summary: Fig 8 is molecular complementarity carried up into architecture: molecules that recognize and bind their partners assemble into complexes, complexes into organelles, organelles into a cell bounded by an extracellular matrix. This study builds that as a six-level nested place graph — extracellular matrix, membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, chromosome, chromatin, nucleosome (with a parallel organelles branch holding the ribosomal complex) — and wires a coupled gene-expression cascade through it, from the deepest leaf outward: transmembrane transport imports nutrients (membrane -> cytoplasm), metabolism turns them into metabolites and energy, transcription reads DNA nested five levels down (`cytoplasm.nucleus.chromosome.chromatin.nucleosome.DNA`) into RNA, translation reads RNA plus a ribosome pool nested in a parallel organelle branch (`cytoplasm.organelles.ribosomal_complex.ribosome`) into protein, and subunit assembly closes the loop back to the ribosome. Measured on the compiled fig08-executable, run 8 seconds through the engine (E. coli-literature rate constants — transcription elongation ~45 nt/s, translation ~15 aa/s, mRNA half-life ~3 min, protein/ribosome dilution at a 30-min doubling; Bremer & Dennis 2008, Milo & Phillips, Bernstein et al. 2002): nutrients rise 0->2.4, metabolites 0->1.5, energy 0->0.84, transport flux 0->0.3 (membrane level), mRNA 0->0.178 and protein 0->0.008 (transcription-translation cascade), and the ribosome pool at the deepest-nested organelle leaf climbs 0.5->0.501 — present and being maintained six levels into the place graph. Compilation preserves the declared interface at every depth (`interface_of(draft) == interface_of(executable)`), which is the strongest test of Law 2 in this codebase: the compiler must find and wire every port from a store nested up to six levels down without moving, renaming, or dropping any of them. Honesty point: the paper's organizing principle for this figure is molecular complementarity and selectivity — the idea that a protein binds its partner and not another, and that this selective recognition is what lets molecules assemble into the right complexes. This executable does not build that. Every process here (transport, metabolism, transcription, translation, assembly) reads and writes fixed, pre-wired store paths — there is no binding-affinity calculation, no competition between alternative partners, and no mechanism that could select a wrong partner and therefore demonstrates selectivity by contrast. What the executable demonstrates is hierarchical assembly: a deep nested place graph that compiles, resolves every store leaf, and carries real coupled dynamics from its deepest node outward. Complementarity/selectivity is narrated as the paper's organizing idea for why such hierarchies form; it is not a mechanism this study builds or tests.
claim: The six-level nested place graph (membrane/cytoplasm/nucleus/chromosome/chromatin/nucleosome, plus a parallel organelles branch) compiles with a coupled transcription->translation->assembly cascade wired to its deepest stores; the interface is preserved through the deepest nesting (Law 2). Complementarity/selectivity is the paper''s organizing principle for why molecules assemble into this hierarchy, but the executable demonstrates hierarchical assembly, not fitted binding selectivity — no partner-choice or binding-affinity mechanism is built or claimed.
key_assumptions: Complementarity/selectivity (which molecular partners bind, and why not others) is the paper''s organizing principle for this figure, not a mechanism implemented here. Every handler (`TransmembraneTransportODE`, `CellMetabolismODE`, `TranscriptionODE`, `TranslationODE`, `SubunitAssemblyODE`, `ReplicationAndRepairODE`) reads and writes a fixed, pre-declared store path — there is no binding-affinity term, no competing-partner choice, and no impostor/non-cognate binder that could be rejected to demonstrate selectivity by contrast. This study tests hierarchical assembly and deep interface preservation, not molecular selectivity.

Interface preserved through the deepest nesting means structural preservation (Law 2) — the compiler resolves and wires every declared port at its nested store path unchanged. It does not mean every leaf in the six-level tree is dynamically driven — several driver pools (`ribosomal_subunits`, `transcription_regulation_complex`, `extracellular_matrix.interstitial_matrix`, `membrane.transmembrane_transporters`) are read by handlers but never written, so they stay at their seed values by construction (they are inputs to the cascade, not its outputs).

DNA (`cytoplasm.nucleus.chromosome.chromatin.nucleosome.DNA`) is actively maintained at a genome set point by `ReplicationAndRepairODE` (synthesis from genes balances dilution), not merely undriven — it stays near 1.0 because replication and dilution are balanced at this parameterization, not because nothing acts on it.

findings.statement: Metabolism feeds the cascade from the membrane inward, each observable rising from zero. Confirmed: nutrients 0 -> 2.4, metabolites 0 -> 1.5, energy 0 -> 0.84.
DNA nested five levels down the place graph is transcribed into a small mRNA pool, and translated into a small protein pool. Confirmed: mRNA 0 -> 0.178, protein 0 -> 0.008.

The interface is preserved and actively driven all the way to the deepest leaf: the ribosome pool, nested six levels down in a parallel organelles branch (cytoplasm.organelles.ribosomal_complex.ribosome), is maintained against dilution by the subunit-assembly loop rather than merely sitting untouched at its seed. Confirmed: ribosome ~0.5 -> ~0.501, structurally wired and dynamically maintained.

Honesty point: complementarity/selectivity — which molecular partners bind, and why not others — is the paper's organizing principle for why this hierarchy assembles, but it is not a mechanism this executable implements or tests. Every handler reads and writes a fixed, pre-declared store path; there is no binding-affinity calculation, no competing partner, and no non-cognate binder that gets rejected. What is demonstrated is hierarchical assembly (a six-level nested place graph that compiles, resolves every leaf, and carries coupled dynamics from its deepest node outward), not fitted binding selectivity. This study does not claim a selectivity mechanism that was not built.

conclusion:
## Claims
- The six-level nested place graph (extracellular matrix, membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, chromosome, chromatin, nucleosome, plus a parallel organelles branch) compiles with a coupled transcription->translation->assembly cascade wired through it: metabolism feeds the cascade (nutrients->2.4, metabolites->1.5, energy->0.84), transcription-translation from the deepest-nested DNA store produces a small mRNA (->0.178) and protein (->0.008) pool, and the ribosome pool at the deepest leaf (six levels down, a parallel organelles branch) is actively maintained (~0.5->0.501) against dilution. The interface is preserved through every nesting depth (Law 2). Complementarity/selectivity is the paper's organizing principle for why such a hierarchy assembles, but this executable demonstrates hierarchical assembly, not fitted binding selectivity — no partner-choice mechanism is built.

## Evidence
- **CASCADE-POPULATES** — nutrients->2.4, metabolites->1.5, energy->0.84, transport flux->0.3
- **MRNA-TRANSCRIBED** — mRNA->0.178, protein->0.008
- **INTERFACE-PRESERVED-TO-DEEPEST-LEAF** — ribosome (six levels nested) ~0.5->0.501, actively maintained against dilution
- **Honesty point** — no binding-affinity, partner-competition, or selectivity mechanism exists in handlers_fig08.py; every store path is fixed and pre-wired

## Limitations
- Complementarity/selectivity — which molecular partners bind and why not others — is narrated as the organizing principle but is not implemented or tested. All wiring is fixed at compile time; there is no competing-partner choice and no non-cognate binder to reject.
- The expression cascade is toy-real: observables rise from zero to illustrative levels using E. coli-literature rate constants, but the constants are not fitted to a measured transcriptome/proteome for a specific organism/condition.
- Several driver pools (ribosomal_subunits, transcription_regulation_complex, and the extracellular_matrix/membrane driver leaves) are read by handlers but never written, so they sit at their seed values by construction — they are cascade inputs, not outputs the study claims to demonstrate dynamics on.

## Next steps
- Add a genuine complementarity/selectivity mechanism — e.g. a binding-affinity term between two or more candidate partners, with a non-cognate impostor rejected or under-selected — so the paper's organizing principle for this figure becomes a tested claim, not a narrated one.
- Wire the ATP synthesized at the molecular-interfaces (Fig 7) grain into this cascade's cytoplasmic energy pool so the molecular mechanism drives the six-level hierarchy quantitatively, closing the loop between the two split studies.

limitations: Complementarity/selectivity (which partners bind, and why not others) is the paper's organizing principle for this figure but is not implemented or tested here. Every handler reads/writes a fixed, pre-declared store path; there is no binding-affinity calculation and no non-cognate binder that could be rejected to demonstrate selectivity by contrast.

One gene-expression cascade at E. coli-literature rate constants; the constants (elongation rates, half-lives, dilution) are grounded in cited literature but are not fitted to a measured transcriptome/proteome for a specific condition.
Nesting depth (six levels) is structural; the study tests interface preservation and cascade dynamics through depth, not compartment-specific transport physics or membrane biophysics.

Several driver pools in the tree (ribosomal_subunits, transcription_regulation_complex, extracellular_matrix.interstitial_matrix, membrane.transmembrane_transporters) are inputs to the cascade and are never written by any handler, so they stay at seed by construction — not evidence of interface failure, but not dynamically demonstrated either.
falsifiability: Overturned if the compiled cascade fails to populate the metabolite or mRNA pools (observables stay at seed), if compilation drops or renames a port at any nesting level (the deepest leaf goes unresolved or undriven), or if the ribosome pool at the deepest leaf is found to be structurally present but never actually wired into the assembly-dilution loop (interface declared but not preserved in practice).
